docs.text:
The aphorisms of Gotama on the means of right knowledge, with the commentary of Vātsyāyana and the gloss of Viśvanātha, in Vidyābhūṣaṇa's English (Allahabad, 1913).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Nyaya Sutras Of Gotama 1913 · M Satisa Chandra Vidyabhusana · 1913, 272 scanned pages. Published 1913; Satis Chandra Vidyabhusana died 1920 and the series editor Baman Das Basu 1930; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
